messages:
Amanda C: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — last night's paging storm. We surfaced repeating alerts from the cache eviction metric that are noisy and probably need dedupe + threshold changes. Can owners pick these up?
Raj P: I can take the dedupe rule work. Planning to look at the signal correlation and write a suppression rule for the noisy emitter. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Tasha M: I'll own threshold tuning for the eviction_rate alert. Need to confirm the right percentile and match on region tags so we don't clobber EU bursts.
Liam G: Heads-up — the cache team wants one-hour cooldown between pages for the same keyset; could that be a runtime suppression? cc @Raj P
Raj P: Yep, will add a conditional cooldown in the dedupe rule: group by keyset and environment, cooldown 3600s. I'll add a guard so it only applies if error_rate < 0.5% to avoid hiding real incidents.
Amanda C: Thanks. Two other asks from the postmortem: (1) add a recurring monthly check to sweep similar signals, (2) assign someone to own the action item tracker until the next retro.
Tasha M: I can schedule the monthly sweep job — will use the alert-sweep lambda and add a dashboard for counts pre/post tuning.
Liam G: I'll temporarily own the tracker until we appoint a permanent owner. I'll post the action list to the tracker by EOD with owners + due dates.
SRE Oncall: ops-bot registered: reminder set - monthly-sweep job will run on 1st of month at 04:00 UTC.
Raj P: Quick note on timelines: dedupe PR -> staging test tomorrow, canary Wednesday, full rollout Thursday if no regressions. I'll add playbook edits for the new suppression logic.
Amanda C: Good. For compliance: make sure the suppression is auditable and reversible. Add a feature flag and a short runbook change.
Tasha M: Will add a comment block in the alert definition and a link to the pm ticket.
Liam G: Action items I have so far: own tracker (until next Monday), collect owners' PR links, verify dashboard changes. Will ping if I need help mapping incidents to signal groups.
Amanda C: Nice. Whoever finishes their PR/changes, drop the link here. I'll follow up in next week's oncall sync for verification. :thumbsup: 
SRE Oncall: ops-bot note: created issue "noise-triage-2256789012" assigned to Liam G; due 2026-04-05.
Raj P: FYI, test snippet I'll use for staging to simulate noisy emitter: ```for i in range(1000): emit_metric('cache.eviction_rate', value=random())```
Tasha M: If anyone wants me to check the EU burst thresholds before rollout, ping me in DMs.
Amanda C: Thanks all — looping back after canary.
